aggregation_note: Completion is the single judge’s strict verdict per run (judged right, an answer, not blocked); every counted run is in the denominator; the Amazon rule (pre-registered) replaced two tasks that ended on Amazon’s block page for every system. Time is per completed task (mean, median beside); rival clocks are their own reported clocks. Cost per completed task: the list-price equivalent of every model call plus our writer calls as billed. Tokens per completed task: the input + output tokens of every metered model call in a row’s counted runs divided by its completed runs; a figure marked “at least” is a lower bound.
